description: Answer-evaluation cases over the frozen Phase 10A corpus. Separate from retrieval_small.json, which stays a retrieval benchmark.

cases.reference_answer: A B-tree index keeps keys sorted and balanced, turning an expensive full scan into a short path to the target record.
Because the cache is bounded, a full cache must evict an entry, and LRU evicts the least recently used one.
A message queue decouples producers from consumers by buffering messages between them.
Each item is mapped to an embedding vector, and similar items have vectors that point in similar directions, measured by cosine similarity.
Lexical matching scores exact term overlap with BM25, semantic matching uses vector embeddings, and a fusion step merges the two ranked lists.
Chunking splits a long document into smaller pieces that fit a fixed context window, and every chunk is embedded into a vector database.
cases.note: The second clause is deliberately absent from the corpus: this case measures a reference that is only partly answerable from the corpus.
